blurb:
For a comprehensive experience during your visit to Los Angeles, consider this private and customizable 7-hour full-day tour. This tour includes visits to notable city locations such as Hollywood, West Hollywood, and Beverly Hills. Additionally, you will travel west to enjoy the scenic beauty of Venice Beach, Santa Monica, and Malibu. You will be accompanied by a highly-rated industry professional guide who is fully licensed and dedicated to showcasing the remarkable aspects of our cities.
